findings.title: The caching tests were deleted instead of updated.
findings.body: The whole `describe("Caching")` block was removed: "should cache authorization conditions" and "should cache filter conditions". The service still caches `cachedAuthConditions` and `cachedFilterConditions`, so that behaviour now has no test coverage. The tests did not need to go. They only needed their expected values switched to `Prisma.sql` the same way as the other tests. Restore them with Prisma.sql expectations.

findings.title: getBaseConditions can return a top-level OR without outer parentheses.
findings.body: When there are no filters, `getBaseConditions()` returns the auth condition as is. For org and team scope that is `(A) AND (B) OR (C) AND (D)`, with no outer parentheses. The same happens with a lone eventTypeId filter, which yields `("eventTypeId" = x) OR ("eventParentId" = x)`. Callers are expected to embed the value in a larger WHERE clause. If one writes `WHERE ${base} AND "createdAt" >= ${start}`, AND binds tighter than OR, so the extra predicate applies only to the last OR branch. The query then returns rows outside the date range, status filter or similar. I could not see the callers to confirm one composes this way. Fix: wrap every returned fragment, e.g. return `Prisma.sql\`(${authConditions})\`` and wrap the reduced OR/AND results, so the value is always safe to embed.

findings.title: The looser constructor type drops compile-time checking of options.
findings.body: The constructor now takes `InsightsBookingServicePublicOptions` (where `teamId` is optional) instead of the discriminated union. So `{ scope: "team" }` without a `teamId` now type-checks. At runtime the zod parse then fails, and the service quietly returns `1=0`, meaning no data, instead of the mistake being caught at compile time. Consider keeping `InsightsBookingServiceOptions` as the parameter type.

held.title: findMany was removed from the public API.
held.body: `findMany(findManyArgs)` was replaced by `getBaseConditions()`, which has a different return type. Any existing caller of `InsightsBookingService.findMany` (for example the insights tRPC router) will fail to compile or break at runtime unless it is updated in this PR. I could not see the other files or callers, so please confirm that every caller was migrated to `$queryRaw` with `getBaseConditions()`.
